code:
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-web \
  --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-web \
  --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 203.0.113.0/24

aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-app \
  --protocol tcp --port 8080 --source-group sg-web
caption: SSH scoped to Meridian's office; the app tier only hears from the web tier.

eyebrow: A role, not a hardcoded key
code:
aws iam create-role --role-name meridian-app-role \
  --assume-role-policy-document file://ec2-trust-policy.json

aws iam create-instance-profile --instance-profile-name meridian-app-profile
aws iam add-role-to-instance-profile ...

aws ec2 associate-iam-instance-profile --instance-id i-0meridianapp \
  --iam-instance-profile Name=meridian-app-profile
caption: Temporary, auto-rotating credentials from instance metadata — nothing to leak.

code:
aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --alarm-name meridian-web-high-cpu \
  --threshold 80 --evaluation-periods 2 \
  --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold ...

aws budgets create-budget --account-id 111122223333 \
  --budget file://meridian-budget.json ...
caption: Two consecutive 5-minute periods above 80% CPU; an alert at 80% of a $150 budget.
